docs.message:
feat: publish the platform design (pdt42) on the docs site

## Intent

The platform design should be readable live on the docs site, next to the vision and the business model, and its changes should be reviewable in pull requests.

## Key changes

- The build validates docs/pdt42 and renders it to /docs/platform-design/, with @pdt42/cli pinned to 0.4.0. Relative asset paths make it work under the sub-path.
- With PDT42_DIFF_BASE set, the build also renders the changes against that base as a single page in platform-design-diff/. While the pinned version has no --diff, the step is skipped with a message.
- In pull requests the Pages workflow fetches the full history, sets the diff base to origin/main and uploads the built site as the artifact site-preview.
- The index page and the README link the new section.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Pull requests produce a downloadable site-preview artifact.
- Main deploys /docs/platform-design/ with the next merge.
